pois.label: SiC 探测舱(剖切)
pois.detail: 柱头剖开的一面就是整条探测因果链:朝堆侧 HDPE 慢化帽把 MeV 级泄漏中子撞软 → ⁶LiF 转换层(30 µm)把热中子变成带电产物 → 4H-SiC PiN 片 2×2(左列贴 LiF 走热道,右列裸片走快道,硅碳反冲+阈值反应)→ 铜读出板 → 前放。中子进、电脉冲出,没有黑盒。
pois.detail_en: The cut-open head is the whole causal chain: the reactor-facing HDPE cap softens MeV leakage neutrons → a 30 µm ⁶LiF converter turns thermals into charged products → a 2×2 stack of 4H-SiC PiN pads (left column behind LiF = thermal channel, right column bare = fast channel via Si/C recoils and threshold reactions) → copper readout board → preamp. Neutrons in, pulses out, no black box.

specs.前端死时间: **≤1 µs(设计要求)**——门控次序不变式的线性前提;10 µs 时 F≳2.5e4 起带电道饱和,方向削弱门控

specs_en.Front-end dead time: **≤1 µs (design requirement)** — the linearity premise of the ordering invariant; at 10 µs the charged channel saturates above F≈2.5e4, eroding the gate

pois.sim: LiF 厚度账(design_rounds 账1):透射几何效率峰 4.72% @ 29.9 µm;Σ_th=54.6 cm⁻¹(俘获平均自由程 183 µm),产物射程 α 5.9 / t 33 µm 封顶自吸收;10 µm 只有 3.0%、60 µm 回落 4.0%——定版 30 µm 落峰肩:**≥95% 峰值的厚度带是 22.5–40.5 µm,即 ±9 µm 内效率损失 <5%**——「容差平坦」到此有了判据,超出该带即不成立。**该效率完全依赖 95% ⁶Li 富集这一设计选择**:换天然 LiF(7.5% ⁶Li)则掉 **11.4 倍**(4.72% → 0.41%),且重新优化厚度也救不回(最优 33 µm 仅 0.42%)。账里 ρ=2.54 g/cm³ 与 M=25.0 g/mol 用的是**富集态**的配对值(天然为 2.64/25.94),二者自洽。
pois.sim_en: LiF thickness account (design_rounds #1): transmission-geometry efficiency peaks at 4.72% at 29.9 µm; Σ_th=54.6 cm⁻¹ (183 µm capture mean free path), product ranges α 5.9 / t 33 µm cap the self-absorption; 10 µm gives only 3.0% and 60 µm falls back to 4.0% — the 30 µm design point sits on the flat shoulder, and «flat» now carries a criterion: the band holding ≥95% of peak is 22.5–40.5 µm, i.e. ±9 µm costs under 5% efficiency — outside that band the claim does not hold. **That efficiency rests entirely on the 95% ⁶Li enrichment, a design choice**: natural LiF (7.5% ⁶Li) costs a factor of **11.4** (4.72% → 0.41%), and re-optimising the thickness does not recover it (33 µm gives only 0.42%). The ledger uses ρ=2.54 g/cm³ with M=25.0 g/mol — the **enriched** pair (natural would be 2.64/25.94); the two are mutually consistent.
pois.physics: ⁶Li(n,α)t,Q=4.78 MeV(α 2.05 + t 2.73 MeV),热截面 940 b。效率峰是一场竞争:层厚→俘获多但产物出不来;层薄→产物全出但俘获少。α 在 SiC 里生成 ~26 万 e-h 对(W=7.8 eV),比 MIP 大两个量级——所以这里用 PiN 就够,不需要增益。
pois.physics_en: ⁶Li(n,α)t, Q=4.78 MeV (α 2.05 + t 2.73 MeV), 940 b thermal cross-section. The peak is a competition: thicker converts more but self-absorbs the products; thinner lets products out but converts less. One α makes ~260k e-h pairs in SiC (W=7.8 eV), two orders above a MIP — a plain PiN suffices, no gain needed.

pois.label: 计数屏 · 围界预期账
pois.detail: 小屏有节奏地跳——每 ~12 秒一个脉冲点。这不是装饰:它就是托卡马克屏蔽账在围界的活体读数,跳的是聚变堆泄漏,不是宇宙线。
pois.detail_en: The little screen blips rhythmically — one pulse every ~1.1 s. Not decoration: it is the tokamak shielding budget read out live at the fence, and what blips is fusion leakage, not cosmic rays.

specs.预期计数率: 0.87 cps(热道 0.78 + 快道 0.09)——机器几何 T·2026-09-19 重算,所印 T 可引用、b 不应用;b 过六缝的并列行 0.63 cps;模型几何下的旧值已作废,建造厚度 0.30 m;旧 0.08 已作废
specs.报警灵敏度: 泄漏 ×10 → 60 s 积分 √N 判 3σ

(**This sentence originally continued "and 0.0155 m deep in it — a factor of 5.7"; that was withdrawn**: the deep point was about one track, Poisson ±100%. The statistically sound spread is **28%, not 5.7×**.) The concrete shield sits behind the whole machine where the spectrum is well softened, so the asymptotic TVL roughly applies, but that is now **to be verified rather than assumed**; directionally, a single TVL **underestimates** the thickness required. **Thickness estimate: a single TVL is usable over short spans (≲2–3 TVL) and the TVL used must be labelled with the spectral position it belongs to; no fixed accuracy is quoted for long-span extrapolation.** (The earlier **"~30% accuracy" was retired on 2026-08-08**: the extension runs found TVL still falling linearly to 0.0551 at 1.00 m of upstream moderation, and linear extrapolation to this network's case (~2.1 m upstream) gives 0.032 — 52% below the reactor's 0.50 m point, far outside a 30% envelope.) The **necessity** of the gate is unaffected (it depends only on the ratio of fractional responses); the ordering margin carries its own precondition (see the three-tier card). **A second premise that had never been written down** (added by reverse audit, partly resolved this round): this account computes throughout as **isotropic bulk transmission**, while the neutron field outside a real tokamak is **dominated by streaming through penetrations**. The azimuth is now resolved: inverting the reactor module's own port implementation (cos a, −sin a) places this group at port angle **a=270°**, exactly mid-way in the 40° gap between the 250° and 290° ports — **20° off the nearest port**, a 20 m lateral offset at 58 m, so relatively favourable rather than a direct line of sight. But the reactor's neutronics ledger has **zero ports and zero penetrations** (a cylindrical layer model), no port-resolved transport exists, and the present nine windows are an LHCD-era layout superseded by ECCD whose launcher geometry is undesigned — so **"no line of sight" cannot be declared; this stands as provisional**. **Moreover, port streaming is an unbounded term that margin cannot cover** (sci-rad-01's margin budget, relayed by control: H*(10) x1.30 and scatter return x2.0 give a coverable factor of 2.6, with port streaming listed as unbounded) => **a thickness chosen on margin must not be described as safe against penetrations; that term has to be closed, not covered.** This network co-signs and holds that statement. => General form: **margin is the tool for bounded terms; using it on an unbounded one is the wrong tool.** **The within-material direct test has landed (2026-08-07)** (this sentence originally continued "and its net verdict points the non-conservative way"; that verdict was withdrawn on 2026-08-08 — see the axis-by-axis locating below): with pre-moderation fixed and only the shield thickness varied, the mid-range (0.025–0.15 m, about 2 TVL) gives segment TVLs of 0.0810 / 0.0818 / 0.0775 — **constant within errors at ≈0.080**, so **a single TVL does hold over short spans**. The legs are therefore unequally supported — (i) limited by span and configuration, (ii) by span alone — so **this is an asymmetric undetermined: leg (ii) stands on firmer ground, and leg (ii) points to the non-conservative side** — the direction the **withdrawn** verdict wrongly claimed for the net as a whole, and which still may not be claimed for it. (This does not reinstate the original verdict — that one failed for never locating the case on each axis, a structural error unrelated to which leg is better supported.) ⇒ The engineering wording is unchanged — **when extrapolating beyond the measured span, round the thickness up and never extrapolate linearly** — but its basis drops from the **withdrawn** "known to err non-conservative" to "**sign unknown, so take the conservative side**". **Hard limitation**: those data reach only 0.20 m ≈ 2.5 TVL, whereas this network's 2 m concrete is roughly **25 TVL and a different material** — so the experiment **supports no quantitative conclusion for this range**, only the qualitative direction above.

pois.label: 4H-SiC PiN · 同源器件
pois.detail: 柱里的探测片与 LGAD 项目(PAN 硅微条改造)同一条外延栈——同样的 50 µm n⁻ 漂移层,只是免掉增益层注入做成 PiN。一次 TCAD 战役,两处收获:PiN 版守围界,LGAD 增益版(d17,M≈5)留给轨道上的 PAN 谱仪升级。宽禁带 3.26 eV 是这里的全部选型理由:室温漏电为零、盲可见光、耐辐照——零冷却、零遮光,火星昼夜温差直接裸跑。
pois.detail_en: The pads share the epitaxial stack of the LGAD project (the PAN silicon-strip conversion) — same 50 µm n⁻ drift layer, minus the gain implant, making a PiN. One TCAD campaign, two deployments: the PiN guards the fence, the gain version (d17, M≈5) is reserved for the orbital PAN upgrade. The 3.26 eV bandgap is the whole selection argument: zero room-temperature leakage, visible-blind, radiation-hard — no cooling, no light-tightening, bare through Martian day-night swings.

specs.n_i: ~8e-9 cm⁻³(比 Si 低 ~18 个数量级)

pois.sim: 漏电流-温度账(design_rounds 账4):SRH 生成电流模型,Si 同几何 300 K 漏 ~nA、350 K 到 µA 级必须制冷;SiC 到 450 K 仍 <1e-20 A。LGAD L2a TCAD 锚点:600 V 反向 IV 全程 1e-31 A/µm——漏电低到击穿都无法从 IV 曲线读出,必须用 McIntyre 电离积分判据。**绝对值的限定**:SRH 模型里的有效态密度取的是 Si 值并同时用于两种材料(本网自设),故**比值 1:9e17 稳健**(共同前置因子相消),而"450 K 仍 <1e-20 A"这类**绝对数应读作量级**;结论方向由 Eg 指数决定,不受影响。
pois.sim_en: Leakage-vs-temperature account (design_rounds #4): SRH generation model — the same geometry in Si leaks ~nA at 300 K and reaches µA by 350 K, demanding cooling; SiC stays <1e-20 A at 450 K. LGAD L2a TCAD anchor: reverse IV flat at 1e-31 A/µm all the way to 600 V — leakage so low that breakdown cannot even be read off the IV curve, forcing the McIntyre ionization-integral criterion. **Caveat on the absolute values**: the SRH model uses silicon effective densities of states for both materials (this network's own assumption), so the **ratio 1:9e17 is robust** (the common prefactor cancels) while absolute figures such as "still <1e-20 A at 450 K" should be read as orders of magnitude; the direction of the conclusion is set by the bandgap exponent and is unaffected.
pois.physics: 生成电流 ∝ n_i ∝ exp(−Eg/2kT):禁带每宽 1 eV,室温本征载流子少 ~8 个数量级。Si 器件在聚变堆围界要制冷要避光;SiC 把这两项预算直接归零——这就是 14 MeV 中子监测的教科书选型。
pois.physics_en: Generation current ∝ n_i ∝ exp(−Eg/2kT): each extra eV of bandgap buys ~8 decades fewer intrinsic carriers at room temperature. A Si device on a fusion fence needs cooling and light-tightening; SiC zeroes both budgets — the textbook choice for 14 MeV neutron monitoring.

pois.detail: 同款柱子布在三个世界:这里(围界,地表)、地下城玄关(30 m 岩下)、深地实验室(3000 m 岩下)。三块屏并排读,就是每层岩石各自吃掉的数量级:围界每 ~1.1 s 一跳(机器几何 T·2026-09-19 重算,所印 T 可引用、b 不应用;b 过六缝的并列行 0.63 cps;模型几何下的旧值已作废;旧 ~12 s 系自设 2 m 档),玄关每 ~1 分钟偶尔一跳,深地几乎纹丝不动——静默本身就是屏蔽账的活体证明。太阳粒子事件里的分工也照这条线划:**真正给 EVA 撤收买到提前量的只有 com-l4-01 日冕仪那一级**(看 CME 起飞,1–3 天结构预报);极轨 EPS 的 ~77 min 是**自由空间的谱弥散间隔**,对轨道资产与事件表征可动作,却不是地表余量——到达时间随能量单调变短,能穿到地面的 >166 MeV 那条带**无能量上界**——首批相对论粒子 ~17 min(光行时硬下限)就到,截止能附近的那批 32 min 才到,**整条带比该窗口所锚的 100 MeV 前锋(39.5 min)先到**;而**轨道对地表剂量起始的领先是 0**:首批相对论粒子确实比剂量主体早 ~15 min 到(2.04 AU 光行时 16.9–17.0 min 是硬下限),但 GeV 级质子远在 166 MeV 大气截止之上,**地表同刻就看得见**——这 15 min 轨道与地表共享,不构成谁对谁的提前量(且要吃满 15 min 得靠相对论尾巴,1 GeV 只买到 12.8 min)。**撤收因此是事件驱动而非窗口驱动:红警即回舱,不按窗口算**——真实余量是剂量累积问题、随事件大小走,最坏档比 77 min 还短(规范值在 sci-rad-01 的剂量卡:F=10⁴ 档仅 ~27 min)。地表被 ~20 g/cm² 大气柱吃掉低能段,物理上报不出早期警报。本网的职责在下游:证实次级场到达、记剂量账,并用地下两柱的零响应给出避难深度的实测衰减下限。
pois.detail_en: The same column stands in three worlds: here at the fence (surface), the undercity foyer (under 30 m of rock), and the deep lab (under 3000 m). Read the three screens side by side and you read the decades each rock layer eats: ~1.1 s blips at the fence (machine-geometry T, recomputed 2026-09-19, the T as printed is quotable, b not applied; the side-by-side row with b over six joins is 0.63 cps; the model-geometry value is void; the old ~12 s was the assumed-2 m case), an occasional blip per minute in the foyer, near-total stillness in the deep — the silence itself is the shielding budget, alive. Solar particle events split along the same line: **the only tier that actually buys EVA evacuation lead time is the com-l4-01 coronagraph** (catching the CME lift-off, a 1–3 day structural forecast). The polar EPS's ~77 minutes is a **free-space spectral dispersion interval** — actionable for orbital assets and event characterisation, but not ground margin: arrival time shortens monotonically with energy, and the >166 MeV band that penetrates to the surface has **no upper energy bound** — its first relativistic members land at ~17 min (the light-travel floor) and those near the cutoff at ~32 min, so **the whole band beats the 100 MeV front (39.5 min) the window is anchored on**; and **orbit leads the onset of surface dose by exactly zero**: the first relativistic particles do arrive ~15 min ahead of the dose main body (the 16.9–17.0 min light-travel time over 2.04 AU is the hard floor), but GeV protons sit far above the 166 MeV atmospheric cutoff, so **the ground sees them at the same instant** — those 15 min are shared by orbit and ground alike and are nobody's lead over anybody (and collecting the full 15 needs the relativistic tail: 1 GeV buys only 12.8 min). **Evacuation is therefore event-driven, not window-driven: on a red alert everyone returns immediately — you do not compute against the window.** The real margin is a dose-accumulation problem that scales with event size, and in the worst bracket it is shorter than 77 min (the normative figures live on the sci-rad-01 dose card: ~27 min at F=10⁴). Ground instruments, under ~20 g/cm² of atmosphere that eats the low-energy end, physically cannot raise an early alarm. This network works downstream: confirm the secondary field has arrived, keep the dose ledger, and turn the two underground columns' zero response into a measured lower bound on shelter attenuation.

两条一起报,不单报有利的那条。⇒ 带电道对中子道的门控是安全关键项:带电道先跳=SEP;带电道不动而中子道抬=真泄漏。**次序可证明安全**:中子道只有 2.03% 由 GCR 喂养、带电道近乎全 GCR,两道分数响应差 22–90×,带电道到黄警态开门时中子道才动 2.2~9.0%;SEP 想"中子道先跳"绕过门控需标度 >49,而实算 0.5–2.2。**该余量有前提**:它来自"中子道仅 2.03% 由 GCR 喂养",而该占比 = GCR份额/(泄漏底座+GCR份额)——**泄漏底座越小余量越薄**。判据的**不变式形式与屏蔽无关**:次序成立 ⟺ 泄漏底座 > GCR份额×(最大标度−1) = 0.0020 cps,当前底座 2.32 cps〔已作废·2026-09-19〕、**裕度 1171×〔已作废·2026-09-19〕**(已分辨口径;旧 39× 系自设 2 m 档)。右边只含本柱仪器参数与谱学量,托卡马克回的厚度/材料/TVL 只动左边。越过它有两个相邻临界:底座 <0.0020 cps 时软谱下次序余量消失;底座再低到 <0.0016 cps(GCR 占比 >50%),**中子道就由「聚变泄漏主导」翻转为「GCR 主导」——那时它测的不再是堆,而是空间天气**,是仪器身份的改变而非余量变薄。⇒ 待托卡马克确认屏蔽设计后,只需按新底座与 0.0020 cps 比一次。**门控只能靠道间分数响应差,不能靠到达时序**——时序判据恰在硬谱区失效(中子滞后:软谱 30 min、硬谱 −0.3 min 即没有),sci-rad-01 已实算否定,后人勿重建。判据真源:由 sci-rad-01 在本站芯片评估并发布事件态,本网**消费该态**;阈值的规范定义只存在于其 alert 卡,本网不复述数字。**失效退化(硬要求)**:轨道预置或事件态一旦链路中断、报文过期或状态存疑,一律退化为**无预置**——中子道抬升按真泄漏处理,**绝不允许 fail 进「SEP 嫌疑」态**(那是唯一能藏住真泄漏的方向);本地带电道独立门控始终在岗,**移除上游预置不影响门控正确性**(预置非承重,只买归因速度)。实现约束:**只做 FLAG 不做 SUBTRACT**——扣除模型化 SEP 中子贡献是唯一能藏住"事件期间真泄漏"的失效模式。架构限定:极轨 EPS 报文是与反应堆无耦合的独立**先验**,但先验不是判别器——排除不掉"SEP 期间恰好真泄漏"这一低概率高后果支;能分辨的只有同址同刻的带电道。EPS×带电道相乘,不可相互替代。 **架构收敛(三条独立理由指向同一处置)**:①SEP 误触发风险;②围界道对"哪一回路破口"零分辨力;③**与屏蔽厚度判据方向冲突**——厚屏蔽让人更安全但让信号更暗、监测更迟钝,薄屏蔽反之,这是真实的设计冲突。**解不是折中厚度,是不让围界柱承担泄漏首判**:一旦它只做确认与边界剂量,屏蔽厚度就纯由职业剂量限值定,张力消失。三条独立理由收敛,比一条硬得多。 **不变式的线性前提(本轮首次检验)**:它默认两道在所有 F 下不饱和。实检:1 µs 前端在 F=1e4 时带电道 4000 cps、死时间仅 0.40%,中子道 ≤0.001% ⇒ **1972 级全程线性,不变式站得住**。但**适用范围有上界**:若前端死时间是 10 µs 量级,F ≳ 2.5e4 起带电道显著饱和,而**饱和方向恰好削弱门控**(带电道被压平、中子道仍线性上升,两道分数响应差缩小)。⇒ **前端死时间列为设计要求(目标 ≤1 µs),不变式适用范围标为 F ≲ 1e4**。 **不变式右边的两个输入(承重但此前在卡上几乎隐形)**:GCR 环境底 **0.0016 cps**(本网自设的地表次级中子通量 0.05 /cm²/s 经叠层响应换算)与硬谱标度 **s_max=2.223**(sci-rad-01 账6 实算,软谱档)。**判据 R_leak > R_gcr(s_max−1) pois.physics: 强子在岩石里按 λ≈150 g/cm² 指数消失;µ 靠电离损失慢慢磨,穿透深得多,所以浅地下的'偶尔一跳'几乎全是 µ;深到 3 km 连 µ 都被磨光,只剩岩石自己的放射性在说话。
pois.physics_en: Hadrons vanish exponentially in rock with λ≈150 g/cm²; muons only grind down by ionization and penetrate far deeper, so the shallow-underground 'occasional blip' is almost pure µ; by 3 km even the muons are gone and only the rock's own radioactivity is left talking.
